If enabled, it selects status selector 1 when manager+0x120 equals 1 and selector 2 otherwise, reads the status value, then writes the difference between the byte-at-entry+8 helper result and the byte0-minus-byte8 helper result. The name matches the gated status-dependent difference. No indexed caller is recorded and direct C call-site search found none. Evidence wording in the proposal should describe the pointer indirection rather than a flat absolute address.
